verdict.rationale: Asana Rules (with rule actions, webhooks, API) and AI Studio's 'powerful no-code automations' support building automations that can trigger on schedule or recurring events to handle routine work, but the evidence never explicitly documents a cron-style/schedule trigger or gives a hands-on example of a recurring automation running end-to-end. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a time-based/recurring trigger option, a concrete example of a scheduled automation in production, and independent/community confirmation of this specific capability working reliably.
